title: Multiple simultaneous safety violations
description: Battery, temperature and attitude violate their limits in the same frame. All three must be reported; clearing only one must not allow recovery.
inject: TELEMETRY seq=2 battery_v=6.5 temp_c=65 attitude_deg=20 comm=UP sensors=VALID
TELEMETRY seq=3 battery_v=7.2 temp_c=65 attitude_deg=20 comm=UP sensors=VALID
